government_groups_citation.claim: Hradec Králové's 2022-2026 governing coalition, formed after the Oct 2022 election, was originally a 5-party 'pětikoalice': Hradecký demokratický klub + TOP 09 ('HDK/TOP09' joint list) + ODS + Piráti + Rozvíjíme Hradec (RH) + Změna pro Hradec a Zelení (ZPHZ) — despite ANO 2011 winning the most seats (13/37), it went into opposition with SPD. Pavlína Springerová (HDK) became primátorka (mayor), the city's first woman in that role.

The coalition later narrowed: the other 4 partners (HDK/TOP09, ODS, Piráti, ZPHZ) terminated their coalition agreement with Rozvíjíme Hradec over its leader Jan Holásek's conduct, pushing RH out. The narrowed 4-party coalition (18 mandates at the time) continued in office, joined by 3 individual defectors originally elected for ANO 2011 (x2) and Rozvíjíme Hradec (x1), who left their own klub and began voting with the coalition without formally joining any of the 4 remaining coalition parties.

Corroborated and made PRECISE by this repo's own feed data (hradec-kralove/data/memberships.csv, built mechanically by party_affiliation.py before this D7 research began, so not tailored to fit the news claim): exactly 3 people currently show 'NEZ' (nezařazení) as their klub, and their dated history matches the news account exactly — Jindřich Outlý and Monika Štayrová both flip from 'ANO 2011' to 'NEZ' on the identical dates (2023-04-25 → 2023-05-30), matching the news description of them leaving together; Ilona Dvořáková flips from 'RH' to 'NEZ' later (2023-11-07 → 2023-12-12), matching the later, separate full RH-coalition breakup. RH's remaining 2 members (Jan Holásek — the leader the other parties explicitly wanted removed — and Petr Nebeský) show continuous RH membership for the whole term with no defection, consistent with RH itself (not just Holásek personally) being pushed into opposition.
sources: hradec-kralove/data/memberships.csv (this repo's own derived data) — internal source-data citation, not an external news claim

resolved_questions.question: RH was a genuine, formal coalition partner for roughly the first 13 months of the term (2022-10-24 to the Holásek breakup) before being pushed out — but this project's govity/wpca schema only supports ONE static government_groups list per definition file, not a dated mid-term change. Include RH for the whole term (wrong for the ~33 post-breakup months) or exclude it for the whole term (wrong for the ~13 pre-breakup months)?
resolved_questions.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-30 by project owner: exclude RH (hradec-kralove:org:group:rh) entirely, as drafted — the lesser inaccuracy given RH spent much longer out of government than in it. No prior city in this project had a genuine mid-term WHOLE-PARTY coalition exit before (as opposed to individual defections, which government_members already models) — flagged as a candidate for a future 'dated government_groups' schema enhancement if this recurs elsewhere.

open_questions_for_owner: The feed's own `lidr` (mayor) field points to Aleš Dohnal (a Piráti councilor), which is WRONG — the real mayor is Pavlína Springerová (HDK), confirmed by news and by the grammatically feminine 'primátorka' label the feed's own `lidr.funkce` text uses (inconsistent with 'Aleš', a male name — the field's ID pointer is unreliable, same caveat already documented for this same `lidr` field on Brno's and Most's feeds). Not used anywhere in this definition, flagging for the record in case a future wpca_definition.json rotation-anchor choice is tempted to trust it.
